subject: Discourse: email to start new topics

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Discourse: email to start new topics
parts:
Hi all,

I've gotten our discourse instance to start topics via email. You can email stan...@mc-stan.org to start a new thread. It needs to come from the email address associated with your discourse account for it to work. I've tested that it bounces emails from other email addresses.

There are actually two emails you can email to start threads. The first is:
- stan...@mc-stan.org. This forwards to the second address.
- mc_stan+...@discoursemail.com

Any email will drop a new topic into the Developers category: http://discourse.mc-stan.org/c/stan-dev

Does everyone have accounts? If you sign up for notifications, you should be able to start and reply to topics and it'll feel like the current setup.


Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: Discourse: email to start new topics
parts:
Thanks.

On this subject, I'll mention "mailing list mode" which might be of
interest to people who would like to preserve the mailing list experience.

You just have to check "Mailing list mode" in your user preferences and
you'll get an email (and can respond via email) with each new post.

Here are some more details:
https://meta.discourse.org/t/what-is-mailing-list-mode/46008

Best,

Allen
